summary: Release PR #6 passes Linux and macOS but Windows exposes three pre-existing test portability defects: executable fixtures lack PATHEXT extensions, causing two handoff detection tests to find zero agents, and one worktree assertion compares native backslashes with Git's forward-slash porcelain path. Await approval to make the focused test-only portability fix before publishing.
